emp_length: The length of time the borrower has been employed in their current job at the time of the loan application.
annual_inc: The borrower’s self-reported annual income provided during the loan application.
credit_years: The age of the borrower’s credit history at the time the loan was issued, measured from the earliest reported credit line.
grade: Lending Club’s assigned credit risk grade based on the borrower’s profile and credit history.
home_ownership: The borrower’s residential ownership status as reported during the loan application or obtained from the credit report.
purpose: The borrower’s stated purpose for requesting the loan.
addr_state: The borrower’s state of residence reported in the loan application.
loan_status: The repayment outcome of the loan, indicating whether the borrower ultimately repaid or defaulted.
open_acc: The number of currently active credit lines in the borrower’s credit file, including open revolving and installment accounts.
